learning_outcomes.text: explain the basic concepts of information systems and describe the tasks and objectives using the tools for analysis and documentation of information systems (use cases, activity diagrams, entity diagrams)
explain the basic instruments for the implementation of database systems
describe the tools and technologies for data presentation on the Web
analyze the information system, describe it and specify the requirements for its function
to implement a simple information system in an environment of databases
present data on the Web, both in static and dynamic form
organize work in a team to achieve a common goal, to use self-assessment within the team to achieve a common goal
to present the results using typical visual presentation tools

syllabus_topics: Introduction - what is an information systems. History and trends.
Global strategies. Enterprise processes. IT strategies.
IS analysis - UML. UML, main models, activity diagram, entity diagram.
Relation data model, relations, attributes. Data base architectures.
Data base application programming. Conceptual modeling.
Built information system using HTML, CSS, PHP, MySQL technologies.
